people.name: Christiana Fordjour
people.bio: Highly accomplished, results-driven Accounting and financial management executive with more than ten years of progressive experience in finance and operations management in Non-Governmental Organizations (NGO) and other sectors. Christiana has good understanding of financial concepts as well as donors’ regulations and policies such as Department for International Development (DFID), and United States Agency for International Development (USAID). She can use accounting software such as Lawson, Tally, QuickBooks, Topaz, Sage Pastel, and Microsoft. Excellent communicator with strong interpersonal focus and reliable team player. Ability to prepare reports and to perform statistical analysis with sound understanding of the Ghana Tax laws.

people.name: Samuel Danso Ahenkorah
people.bio: Samuel is a highly organised and dedicated person with a proven ability in managing project funds to achieve project goals. He has over seven years of working experience in positions of trust. Samuel possesses strong computer skills and has demonstrable proficiency in accounting software such as Tally, Sage, and QuickBooks. He assisted with the successful management of the books of accounts of both for-profit and not-for-profit organisations in various capacities, including management assistant, account clerk, accounts officer, finance assistant, and finance officer. He has played key roles in accounting software implementation, financial controls, financial reporting and compliance. Samuel possesses experience in project accounting and reporting.

people.name: Daniel Zewu
people.bio: Daniel a financial accountant with skills and experience in managing financial accounting records, account payable and financial reporting. He possesses good communication and negotiation skills, analytical to providing sound financial advice. Daniel supports with the day-to-day financial administration of the organization. As part of his role, he examines financial records to check for accuracy and assists in preparing month-end financial reports.  He holds a Bachelor of Science Degree in Accounting from the Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA), a Higher National Diploma in Accounting from the Accra Technical University. Daniel has a wealth of skills and experience in supporting operational, administration and customer service projects.

people.name: Chantelle Iris Nunoo
people.bio:
With a positive personality, excellent communication, and problem-solving skills, Chantelle will assist T-TEL with strong administrative support. She holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Management from the University of Cape Coast. She also attained a Higher National Diploma in Secretaryship & Management studies at the Accra Technical University.

Chantelle is a proactive, results-oriented, and highly skilled administrative specialist with over 6 years’ experience contributing to challenging corporate environments. She is a team player who works collaboratively and effectively communicates with all staff and clients. Chantelle brings on board an exceptional track record in customer service, record keeping, and general office management.

people.name: Francis Tetteh
people.bio:
Popularly known as 'Onasis', Frank Osei Debrah is a content professional defensive driver with fourteen years of experience. A multi-skilled person with well developed administrative skills, high sense of humour, integrity, self-motivated, initiative driven, team player, good communicator,

people/event management, adaptability and stress tolerance.

He is a powerful force in the workplace and uses his positive attitude and tireless energy to encourage others to work hard and succeed.

Onasis's dedication to work has earned him several awards in his working career, some of which are;

- Best Logistics officer 2014

- Promotion - Driver to operation assistant 2017

- Outstanding Worker 2019

- Outstanding Worker 2020

Onasis loves driving, travelling, cooking, reading scriptures and making people happy.

people.name: Rocky Asuman
people.bio:
Benedicta is an ambitious and zealous lady who seeks to grow professionally and contribute to significant organizational objectives. She is willing to bring her innovativeness to bear to achieve desired results in a professional environment.

She has years of experience in Administrative and fleet management roles.

She is proactive, firm, and approachable, and a team player.

people.name: Isaac Asamoah
people.bio: Joseph George Ocran is an HR professional with a strong emphasis on strategic thinking and innovation. He is passionate about positioning HR as a true business partner, driving excellence in performance, profitability, growth, and employee engagement. Joseph brings a unique perspective to the field, recognizing that human capital is the most valuable asset of any organization. He excels in navigating complex challenges and transforming visions and strategies into actionable, value-added goals.
